mentions.name: weather_mcp
mentions.description: An MCP tool that fetches current weather and 5-hour forecasts from the OpenWeather API using only latitude and longitude coordinates. Designed for the free API tier (60 requests/hour) and completely parametrized for easy extension.
mentions.source_excerpt: A simple weather MCP tool using OpenWeather API. Only requires lat + long to fetch current and 5-hour forecasts. Designed for the free API (60 req/h) but completely parametrized and easily extensible.
